clasico.description: The current CRM theme: white, lime green, no effects. It stays as it is.

pafpaf.name: PafPaf
pafpaf.description: White minimalism with large corners. Flowing gradient borders on what matters.

nagual.name: Nagual
nagual.description: Emerald and gold, serifs and sacred geometry. Fireflies on check-in; a breathing pause when closing the till.

unicornio.name: Unicorn
unicornio.description: Rainbow glass and pastels. Sparkles follow the cursor, confetti when a member walks in.

galaxia.name: Distant galaxy
galaxia.description: Parallax stars and HUD labels. A jump to hyperspace when you switch sections.

asceta.name: Ascetic
asceta.description: Pure black for OLED screens, one accent, big buttons, zero animation. Dims after 20 s idle.

cristal.name: Crystal
cristal.description: Glass panels over a photo of your club. Upload your own background.

vapor.name: Vapor
vapor.description: Holographic vapor: iridescent borders, shimmering figures and coloured mist.

brasa.name: Embers
brasa.description: Warm lounge: embers rising through the background, narrow headlines.

trap.name: Trap
trap.description: Street: pink and acid yellow, statuses as stickers, graffiti tags on titles.

noventa.name: 90s
noventa.description: Newsprint and hard shadows. Counters flip like a tape deck, the log runs on VHS timecode.

grind.name: Grind
grind.description: Black and blood. A denied entry leaves a red stamp and shakes the card.

mediterraneo.name: Mediterranean
mediterraneo.description: Costa Blanca: whitewash, sea blue, terracotta and azulejos in the menu. Calm, no effects.

sociopath.name: Sociopath
sociopath.description: Graphite and a single red. A bleeding smiley as wallpaper, no frames — only rounded corners.

black.name: Black
black.description: Matte black and graphite, no frames, big rounded corners, fraktur headings. Somewhere, blood drips.

coqueta.name: Coquette
coqueta.description: Juicy pink: glossy buttons, powder by day and neon by night. Hearts float behind the page, a kiss hides on the logo.

burberry.name: Burberry
burberry.description: The heritage check — camel, black, white and a red thread — on the menu and the header, cream cards, serif headings. The mark wears a flat cap.
